clues.text: This family wooden coaster reaches a height of 55 feet and hits a top speed of 40 mph with zero inversions.
Built by Gravitykraft Corporation, this coaster welcomed its first riders in 2024.
You can find this ride operating in the state of New York.
This wooden coaster at Great Escape was built on the former site of Alpine Bobsled, even reusing that ride's old station building.
The ride shares its name with a fierce, short-tailed wildcat native to North America.

evidence.quote: The Bobcat is a wooden roller coaster built by The Gravity Group at Great Escape in Queensbury, New York, USA.
It was built on the former site of Alpine Bobsled, which closed in 2023. Its former station was also reused.
